links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated prostate cancer patient information (ARI, Flesch, Gunning Fog, FKGL)
links.effect: DeepSeek ARI higher than ChatGPT (12.63±1.42 vs 10.85±1.93, p<0.001), indicating greater textual complexity and reading difficulty; both above typical patient reading levels.
links.quote: However, the ARI for DeepSeek was higher than that for ChatGPT (12.63±1.42 vs. 10.85±1.93, p<0.001), indicating greater textual complexity and reading difficulty.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of the readability, understandability, and quality of prostate-cancer patient information generated by ChatGPT and DeepSeek without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
